limitations: Four session-inspired synthetic tasks; not a replay of complete private sessions.
Independent one-use tasks; no warmed command state or controlled provider input cache.
Linux runtime, actual CLI/Git/gh, API-only localhost overlay with CLI invocation logging.
Local API latency is not GitHub production latency. Direct GraphQL batching is supported.
Malformed JUnit case is an explicit error scenario, separate from regular efficiency.
No direct comparison to earlier different fixtures, model defaults or output scopes.

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import re
import stat
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

path = Path('settings.py')
original = path.read_bytes()
original_mode = stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode)
assert b'\\r\\n' in original
assert b'\\n' not in original.replace(b'\\r\\n', b'')
assert b'\\r' not in original.replace(b'\\r\\n', b'')
retry = re.compile(rb'(?m)"'^retry_budget='"\\d+(?=\\r\\n|"'$)'"')
